125    /**
126     * A random CPF number.
127     *
128     * @see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadastro_de_Pessoas_F%C3%ADsicas
129     *
130     * @param bool $formatted If the number should have dots/dashes or not.
131     *
132     * @return string
133     */
134    public function cpf($formatted = true)
135    {
136        $n = $this->generator->numerify('#########');
137        $n .= check_digit($n);
138        $n .= check_digit($n);
139
140        return $formatted ? vsprintf('%d%d%d.%d%d%d.%d%d%d-%d%d', str_split($n)) : $n;
141    }
142
143    /**
144     * A random RG number, following Sao Paulo state's rules.
145     *
146     * @see http://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/C%C3%A9dula_de_identidade
147     *
148     * @param bool $formatted If the number should have dots/dashes or not.
149     *
150     * @return string
151     */
152    public function rg($formatted = true)
153    {
154        $n = $this->generator->numerify('########');
155        $n .= check_digit($n);
156
157        return $formatted ? vsprintf('%d%d.%d%d%d.%d%d%d-%s', str_split($n)) : $n;
158    }
